watches.name: Worldmaster Hybrid Limited Edition
watches.description: A first of its kind for Atlantic. The Worldmaster Hybrid Limited Edition brings an automatic Sellita SW-100A and a quartz ETA 901.001 together in one Swiss Made watch. Two independent dials, two movements and one rare expression of time. Limited to 188 pieces worldwide. [vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=”” css_params=””] The Worldmaster Hybrid Limited Edition opens a new chapter in Atlantic’s history. For the first time, one Atlantic watch brings together two independent movements: an automatic Sellita SW-100A and a quartz ETA 901.001. Two dials. Two rhythms. One rare Swiss Made timepiece. Two movements in one watch On the right side, the automatic movement brings the mechanical soul of traditional watchmaking to life. On the left side, the quartz movement adds everyday precision and clarity. Both dials operate independently, giving the watch its unmistakable hybrid character. This is a Worldmaster unlike any before. It combines Atlantic’s classic watchmaking heritage with an unusual technical idea, creating a piece that feels refined, collectible and genuinely different. Refined details, Swiss Made precision The 40 mm sandblasted stainless steel case gives the watch a soft, sophisticated presence on the wrist. Rose gold plated crowns on both sides add a warm contrast, while the sandblasted grey dial with rose gold subdials gives the watch depth and balance. A domed sapphire crystal with double-sided anti-reflective coating protects the dial. The transparent sapphire crystal caseback reveals the automatic movement and carries the individually numbered limited edition engraving. The watch is delivered on a sandblasted stainless steel bracelet with quick release system and includes a second calf leather strap with stitching. Presented in a special edition box with Certificate of Authenticity, the Worldmaster Hybrid Limited Edition is limited to 188 pieces worldwide. [/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Inside the 42 mm case beats the legendary ETA Valjoux 7750, a movement admired by collectors for its reliability, its character and its historic importance in Swiss watchmaking. A deep black dial with golden accents brings warmth and sophistication, while the sapphire crystal preserves perfect visibility over time. Every piece comes in a special presentation box bearing his signature, turning the unboxing into a moment of its own. The watch is accompanied by two genuine leather straps in classic racing style: a black strap with a butterfly clasp and a brown strap with a pin buckle. Switching between them transforms the character instantly from contemporary sportiness to warm vintage charm. Limited to just 177 pieces, this edition stands as a tribute to precision, courage and timeless design — values shared by both Atlantic and the man who inspired it. About Krzysztof Holowczyc Krzysztof Holowczyc is one of Poland’s most accomplished and admired rally drivers, known for his precision, consistency and unmistakable charm behind the wheel. A European Rally Champion, multiple national champion and Dakar Rally podium finisher, he built a career defined by discipline, courage and a relentless drive for excellence. His partnership with Atlantic reflects these shared values — timeless craftsmanship, dedication and an enduring passion for performance.

It combines the sophistication of the past with the technological advancements of today, creating an exemplary wristwear experience. The watch is powered by a reliable Sellita SW279-1 automatic movement, wrapped in polished stainless steel, with a functional power reserve indicator and small second hand. A perfect tribute to the iconic Worldmaster of the 50s, this 39mm model offers a stylish blast from the past with modern horological precision. Atlantic Worldmaster Original Power Reserve – A Stunning Masterpiece Experience the perfect marriage of retro charm and modern horology with the Atlantic Worldmaster Original Power Reserve Watch. Inspired by the classic designs of the 1950s, this timepiece is a nod to Atlantic’s rich heritage while accommodating the precise mechanical enhancements of contemporary watchmaking. The heart of this piece is the highly reliable Sellita SW279-1 automatic movement. Known for its accuracy and longevity, this movement is not only a testament to Swiss craftsmanship, but it also fuels the functional elegance of the timepiece. It manifests itself via the power reserve indicator positioned at 6 o’clock and the small second sub-dial situated at 9 o’clock. These features not only enhance the timepiece’s utility but also contribute to its vintage allure, crafting a sophisticated blend of form and function. The power reserve indicator is a practical and desirable feature, showing the wearer how much longer the watch will operate without being wound. It adds an element of interaction and anticipation to the experience of wearing this automatic timepiece, creating a bond between the watch and its wearer. The vintage-retro look of the Atlantic Worldmaster Original Power Reserve is a nostalgic journey to the golden era of watch design, making this timepiece not just a method to tell time, but a wearable story of time itself. Whether you’re a vintage watch enthusiast or simply love a timepiece with a story, the Atlantic Worldmaster Original Power Reserve is a perfect choice.
